description: tool:cbimport and tool:cbexport were each independently minted under three spellings across earlier rounds before this round's own reference pages were read: tool:cbimport/tool:cbexport (from Capella's command-line-tools.json), server:cbimport/server:cbexport (from cloud/connect/cli-import-export.json and cloud/guides/load.json), and capella:cbexport (from cloud/clusters/data-service/export.json). Verified rather than assumed: export.json's own relation is `capella:cbexport seeAlso server/current/tools/cbexport-json`, quoting 'The cbexport json command-line tool exports data from Capella to JSON format' - a direct cross-reference confirming all three spellings name the identical CLI tool, not a distinct UI/REST surface. Folded into tool:cbimport/tool:cbexport. This is a fork about the concept's NAME rather than its REFERENT - the underlying tool was always correctly understood as one thing on each page; only the id disagreed.
